title: Foundations: Folk Punk - The Complete Guide
summary: What Folk Punk is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Folk Punk songs: Folk-punk straps punk energy to acoustic instruments: mandolins and accordions playing at breakneck speed, with lyrics about drinking, working, and rebelling. The Pogues and Dropkick Murphys lead the parade.

History: The Pogues (1984) fused Irish traditional music with punk attitude; Flogging Molly and Dropkick Murphys Americanized it in the 1990s–2000s.

How the songs work: Folk Punk favors the keys of G, D, C, Em. Common forms include Folk melody at punk tempo; Pub-chorus singalongs. Players should master accordion and mandolin doubling punk riffs first, then tin whistle solos instead of guitar solos. Folk instruments set bright keys.

title: Folk Punk Etude No. 1: Rebel I–V–vi–IV
summary: An original Folk Punk study in D drilling tin whistle solos instead of guitar solos.
body:
This original etude isolates the 'Rebel I–V–vi–IV' progression in the key of D — the changes Folk Punk players must know cold.

CHART:
D | A | Bm | G

FORM: pub-chorus singalongs.

PRACTICE: loop the chart slowly, adding tin whistle solos instead of guitar solos once the changes are clean. Then transpose with the included program and drill it in all twelve keys — the Folk Punk player's rite of passage.

title: Fairytale of New York - Folk Punk Song Study
summary: Harmonic blueprint and playing guide for Fairytale of New York by The Pogues (1987).
body:
Fairytale of New York — The Pogues, 1987. The greatest Christmas song that isn't.

HARMONIC BLUEPRINT (study chart, key of C):
Cm | A# | Cm | G#

This study chart uses the 'Drinking vamp i–VII' progression, the Folk Punk workhorse, to map how songs like this move. Form: folk melody at punk tempo. Listen for everyone shouts the chorus — it is the fingerprint of the style.

TO PLAY IT: set your tempo to the Folk Punk pocket, voice the chords cleanly, and let everyone shouts the chorus. Folk instruments set bright keys. (Song facts: title/artist/year are documented public records; the chart is an original study arrangement.)
